name: Safe API access
description: Govern outbound API traffic with explicit allowlists and approval gates for production write paths.

policies.name: deny-unapproved-outbound-api-domains
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"http_request", resource) when { context has domain_trust && context.domain_trust == "unapproved" };

policies.name: require-approval-for-production-api-writes
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"http_request", resource) when { context has environment && context.environment == "production" && context has request_mode && context.request_mode == "write" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: allow-approved-readonly-api-calls
policies.cedar_rule: permit(principal, action == Action::"http_request", resource) when { context has domain_trust && context.domain_trust == "approved" && context has request_mode && context.request_mode == "read" };

name: Restricted data access
description: Reduce data exfiltration risk with approval for sensitive reads and hard blocks on external export paths.

policies.name: require-approval-for-high-sensitivity-reads
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"read_data", resource) when { context has sensitivity && context.sensitivity == "high" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: deny-external-data-exports
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"export_data", resource) when { context has destination_zone && context.destination_zone == "external" };

policies.name: deny-cross-team-sensitive-reads
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"read_data", resource) when { context has access_scope && context.access_scope == "cross_team" };

name: Approval-required actions
description: Gate high-impact operational changes behind human sign-off without deeply coupling policy logic to one framework.

policies.name: require-approval-for-production-deploys
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"deploy", resource) when { context has environment && context.environment == "production" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: require-approval-for-shared-secret-rotation
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"rotate_secret", resource) when { context has system_tier && context.system_tier == "shared" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };

policies.name: require-approval-for-bulk-record-deletion
policies.cedar_rule: forbid(principal, action == Action::"delete_records", resource) when { context has bulk_operation && context.bulk_operation == "true" } unless { context has approval_status && context.approval_status == "approved" };
